responsibility: Defines the shared const-checking context and module-level utilities for MIR const validation, including item classification, const-stability queries, panic/lang-item recognition, and the entry-point types used by the const-checking submodules.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the root for the const-checking support code inside MIR transforms, defining shared context and utilities used by const validation passes. It differs from `const_eval/mod.rs`, which executes constants, and from `transform/mod.rs`, which schedules the full MIR pass pipeline.
